## How to apply [...] ## Timelines & Process

Selection Process

Applications will undergo an initial screening to ensure all submission requirements are met. Eligible projects will then proceed to the judging phase, which will take place between December 1 and December 15, 2026. Submissions will be evaluated by a panel of expert judges, including engineers from NVIDIA and Nebius, as well as staff from Tavily. Each project will be scored equally across four key criteria: Technological Implementation, Design, Potential Impact, and Quality of the Idea. The judges will assess the novelty, functionality, feasibility, and overall impact of the AI systems developed. The winners will be selected based on these evaluations and announced on or around January 11, 2027.

## Who should apply

This hackathon is for AI and ML engineers, application developers, agent builders, startup teams and anyone interested in turning an AI idea into a working project.

Attendance is approval-based and places are limited. [...] More technology and application partners will be joining soon, bringing additional challenges, tools and prizes.

Prizes will be awarded to standout projects across the main tracks and partner challenges.

## Choose your track

## Cloud & Serverless

Build and deploy AI services, inference endpoints, evaluation pipelines or reusable deployment templates using Nebius infrastructure.

## Apps & Agentic AI

Create agents and AI applications that solve real problems using open models, Nebius Token Factory and Tavily for real-time web search.

## Vertical AI

Build for areas such as healthcare and life sciences, physical AI, robotics, and retail.

## Agenda

09:00-10:00 — Registration, breakfast, networking and team formation

10:00-10:20 — Welcome, opening keynote and challenge briefing [...] # Nebius Build Week Hackathon in partnership with NVIDIA

Build something real before GTC Berlin begins

On Sunday, 18 October, Nebius is bringing together around 250 AI engineers, agent builders, startup teams and technical practitioners for a full day of hands-on building in Berlin.

Teams will use Nebius AI Cloud, Serverless, Token Factory, Tavily and NVIDIA technologies to build practical AI applications, agents and workflows. The day starts with technical workshops, followed by more than six hours of hacking, support from onsite mentors, and final demos and judging.

Participants will also be able to build with NVIDIA Nemotron through Nebius Token Factory as part of a dedicated NVIDIA challenge. NVIDIA will support the event with workshops, technical resources, mentors and judges.
